content.value: You are given an IPv4 datagram described in hexadecimal format: “4640 001C 00D1 00B9 (15) 1E11 DE0B 4AFA 0A14 C878 321E 0000 000F 0272 6F9A". Answer the following questions based on the given datagram (in decimal)
v) Is it a fragmented packet? If yes, does the packet has any specialty?
vi) Which fields will get updated if the packet is sent to the next hop router?
